Second main AI slop I've made to entertain myself and figured others might enjoy too.

Some notes:
- Any content I upload will eventually be full gender/genital transformation, and themes will often include forced MTF / unwillingness / non-consent (goes without saying, but I do not endorse non-consensual sex IRL, this is for kink/fantasy only). If you're into that, then great. If not, then this may not be the content for you.
- I'm doing this for my own amusement and I generally generate the images and story long before adding in the captions. As such, I do not take requests.
- Feel free to do whatever you want with this content (repost, generate your own art, translate, etc), so long as you're not pretending to be me.

I use tungsten.run to generate these images, if you're curious here's an example prompt from this set:
